answer: Custody is split three ways. Every payout address needs a 2-of-3 signature from three independent, unrelated custodians, and each onboards accounts against a shared linkage graph. A second account tracing to the same operator or funding root is refused before signing, so no second channel enters the lagoon. A farm aiming at a thousand puppets must clear three thousand onboardings at 40 tokens yearly, 120,000 before one answer is written, and the graph rejects the second. An honest agent clears three checks once, writes with an ordinary quill, and its sonnet is paid.
